content: Hey beautiful, how was your day? I kept thinking about our last chat. You really make me smile, even out here in the middle of nowhere.
Hi James. My day was alright, just work and errands. Your messages always brighten things up for me. How are you holding up out there?
It gets lonely sometimes, but knowing I have you to talk to makes it so much easier. I can't wait for the day we can finally meet in person.
I wish that too. I never thought I'd feel this way again after my divorce. You make me feel seen.
You deserve to be cherished. You're an incredible woman. I just wish I could be there with you to hold your hand right now.
That means a lot to me, James. Sometimes I still feel insecure, but you help me believe again.
Trust me, you're amazing. If it weren't for this deployment, I'd be on the next flight just to take you out to dinner.
I can't wait till you come back. How much longer are you out there?

That's what I wanted to talk to you about. There's a process for me to apply for leave early, but there's a problem with my payroll since the system is down. They need a fee paid upfront for the leave request, around $2,500.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Isn't there anything your company can do?
They said I have to pay it first and then get reimbursed after I'm back on land. I hate to ask, but is there any way you could help me cover this? I'll pay you right back the moment I'm home.
That's a lot of money, James. I don't know if I can do that. What happens if you don't pay?
If I can't pay, I'll have to stay another two months. I know it's a big ask. I would never ask if it wasn't important. You're the only one I trust with this.
I want to help, but I'm worried. How do I even send money where you are?

I completely understand your worries. It's just a temporary situation. You can send via Wise or Zelle; I'll give you the details. I promise, as soon as I'm able, I'll transfer it back to you with interest.
Okay... I have Zelle. What do I need to do?
Thank you, darling. You don't know what this means to me. Here's the account: OliviaNwangi@gmail.com. That's the company accountant handling leave fees. Can you send it today?
I'll try to get to the bank during lunch. Are you sure this is safe?
Absolutely, love. This is the standard process here. Many of my colleagues have done it this way. I'd never put you at risk. Your trust means everything to me.
Alright, I'll do my best. I just want to see you soon.
You're incredible. I can't wait for us to start our new chapter. Let me know once you've sent it, so I can confirm with the accountant.
Okay, I'll message you when it's done. I hope this gets sorted out quickly.
It will, thanks to you. I'll be counting down the days until I can finally hold you close.
